title: Stirling R9248 Memorial, Saint-Thégonnec Loc-Eguiner
memorial_details: A memorial at Saint-Thégonnec Loc-Eguiner, Finistère. No. 75 (New Zealand) Squadron operated Short Stirlings between October 1942 and March 1944, giving the probable date range for this loss. The primary French sources for Brittany crash sites (crash-aerien.aero, Archives du Finistère) were not accessible at the time of research. One crew member is reported to have evaded capture. Memorial type, inscription, and exact location are not confirmed from open sources.
crew_summary: One crew member reported to have evaded capture. Remaining crew fates and identities not yet confirmed.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Short Stirling (confirms 75 NZ Sqn operated Stirlings Oct 1942–Mar 1944)
